shots.name: The Rejection Pile
shots.visual: A student tosses a folder labeled B.Com into a trash bin, holding a BBA folder.
shots.dialogue: B.Com is just for accounting, so I'm skipping it for BBA.
shots.onscreenText: B.Com vs BBA: Why I'm choosing.
shots.cameraPerformance: Close-up on the student's face, decisive expression.

shots.name: The Assumption
shots.visual: Student opens the BBA document, pointing at the Semester I course list.
shots.dialogue: I thought BBA was the only place for management subjects.

shots.name: The Comparison
shots.visual: Split-screen: B.Com and BBA documents appear side-by-side on a laptop screen.
shots.dialogue: Wait, look at the Semester I lists for both.
shots.cameraPerformance: Fast zoom onto the common module text.

shots.name: The Evidence Reveal
shots.visual: Highlighting the specific row in both PDFs with a cursor.
shots.dialogue: Both include Business Organization & Management. Degree labels don't tell the whole story.
shots.cameraPerformance: Clear, steady shot of the digital document.

shots.name: The New Perspective
shots.visual: Student retrieves the B.Com folder from the bin and places it next to the BBA folder.
shots.dialogue: How can I compare the specific module requirements for the remaining semesters in these two documents?
shots.cameraPerformance: Wide shot of desk with both folders open.

shots.name: The Next Step
shots.visual: Student begins taking notes on a notepad marked 'Comparison'.
shots.dialogue: Start comparing your official course documents today.
shots.cameraPerformance: Final close-up on the pen writing on the notepad.

productionNotes.camera: Stable, tripod-mounted for documents, handheld for the student.

creativeSummary.keyCreativeIdea: Use a side-by-side document comparison to challenge the assumption that degree titles create rigid subject silos.
